Here is the sandbox: https://codesandbox.io/s/instantsearch-radio-menu-with-counts-bowln.

Actually, with a fresh head I have managed it to work, however I'm not satisfied with that it gets rendered several times with intermediate set of refined values. This is seen in the console.

I'm calling `refine` in a loop to toggle the facet values, and I expect Instantsearch to trigger the search asynchronously, after all the calls are finished. Any idea on how to achieve the desired behavior?
